sentences.text: Rupert Wyatt -LRB- born 26 October 1972 -RRB- is an English screenwriter , director , and producer .
He made his directorial debut with the 2008 film The Escapist , which premiered at the Sundance Film Festival .	The Escapist	The Escapist (2008 film)	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival
